name: Gatorskin

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

positioning: Puncture-resistant training and commuting tire with a PolyX breaker.
weight_basis: Continental folding-bead claims; wire-bead versions weigh 70-80 g more.
pressure_note: The product table does not list maximum pressures; use the figure printed on the tire.

availability.note: Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers; not found in Continental's official Tmall store on 2026-11-01.

caveats: Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2015 Gatorskin test is too old to apply to current production.
Folding and wire-bead versions share the name; check bead and weight.

image.shown: Black Gatorskin with its yellow sidewall logo, as pictured on Continental's US road-tire range page; the same picture covers every width, and the folding and wire-bead versions are not distinguished.
image.alt: Continental Gatorskin road tire with its yellow sidewall logo
